description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximam Retail Prices for Sale the Local Varieties of Rice
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum retail prices for specific rice varieties, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory matters rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
